texts:
Serve or Sit for Week 6: the lineup calls you are stuck on, from Thursday night to the coin flips.

Bhayshul Tuten is RB15 for me, an RB2.

Lamar Jackson falls outside my top 12.

Let's dive in.
#DUUUVAL #RavensFlock

Thursday night, SEA @DEN, 8:15 PM ET. Seattle is a 2.5-point favorite, the total is 40.5, and Pat Surtain II is not in line to play.

Jaxon Smith-Njigba: full practice Wednesday, no designation. WR2 for me tonight.
#Seahawks #BroncosCountry

Emanuel Wilson: 20 carries vs SF, and Zach Charbonnet stays on PUP. RB16 for me tonight, an RB2.

Bo Nix: 123 yards @LAC, and his best rushing game is 10 yards. QB23 for me; sit him tonight.
#Seahawks #BroncosCountry

J.K. Dobbins: 18 of Denver's 22 RB carries @LAC. RB27 for me tonight, a high-end RB3.

RJ Harvey: 1 target @LAC after 10 catches the week before. RB25 for me, a high-end RB3 on a role that just shrank.
#BroncosCountry

Jaylen Waddle: 10 catches for 66 yards across four games outside Week 2, and 40 snaps @LAC to Courtland Sutton's 50.
WR26 for me tonight, a high-end WR3 with a low floor.
#BroncosCountry

Bhayshul Tuten: 22 of the 24 Jaguars RB carries in London. RB15 for me this week, an RB2.

Trevor Lawrence: 331 yards vs PHI in London. QB12 for me vs HOU, a borderline start this week.
#DUUUVAL

Brenton Strange: 14 of 16 targets for 163 the last two weeks. TE12 for me, a borderline start this week.

Woody Marks: 56 of 65 snaps at TEN, and David Montgomery missed practice again. RB20 for me @JAX, an RB2.
#DUUUVAL #HTownMade

Cam Skattebo: 63 percent of the RB snaps @WAS despite another fumble. RB17 for me vs NO, an RB2.

Braelon Allen: all but two snaps the last time Breece Hall sat. RB19 for me @NE, an RB2.
#NYGiants #JetUp

Denzel Boston: a route on 91 percent of dropbacks and 7 targets @NYJ. WR19 for me vs BAL, a WR2.

Luther Burden III: a 25 percent target share through three games, and Caleb Williams is back. WR20 for me @ATL, a WR2.
#DawgPound #DaBears

Germie Bernard: 32 routes on 34 dropbacks and 9 targets vs IND. WR34 for me @TB, a low-end WR3.

Pat Freiermuth: 4 TDs in five games with three Steelers receivers out. TE13 for me, a borderline start this week.
#HereWeGo

Tyler Warren: 7 of 9 for 83 at PIT plus a 1-yard rushing TD. TE5 for me vs TEN.

Keenan Allen: 9 targets in each of his last two games, with Alec Pierce on IR. WR38 for me, a low-end flex play to a dart throw.
#ForTheShoe

Kendrick Bourne: a team-high 70 yards on 8 targets vs DET, and Marvin Harrison Jr. is in Houston now.
WR36 for me @LAR, a low-end WR3 and a low-end flex play.
#BirdGang

Lamar Jackson: no practice since the Oct. 4 ankle injury. QB16 for me @CLE, a streamer; sit him for any QB in my top 12 unless he practices in full by Friday.

Mark Andrews: three drops and a lost fumble at ATL. TE14 for me; sit him for Brenton Strange.
#RavensFlock #DUUUVAL

Aaron Rodgers: three straight 3-TD games, but 235 yards vs IND and the lowest total of the week @TB. QB18 for me, a streamer; sit him for any QB in my top 12.

Chris Godwin Jr.: 10 catches for 111 through three games. WR47 for me, a dart throw; sit him.
#HereWeGo #GoBucs

Justin Herbert: no game over 15 fantasy points in five tries, sacked 5 times vs DEN. QB24 for me @KC; sit him.

Quinshon Judkins: no practice Wednesday with the right ankle. RB33 for me vs BAL, a low-end RB3; sit him unless he practices by Friday.
#BoltUp #DawgPound

Rachaad White: 7 carries for 18 on 37 snaps vs NYG, while Jacory Croskey-Merritt ran 11 for 82. RB35 for me @SF; sit him.

Dameon Pierce: 11 carries for 14 @JAX. RB30 for me; sit him until Friday's report rules out Saquon Barkley.
#RaiseHail #FlyEaglesFly

Colston Loveland: 2 of 5 for 19 at GB, and no catches in Week 1 with Caleb Williams at quarterback.
TE15 for me @ATL, a streamer; sit him.
#DaBears

Coin flips.

Caleb Williams vs Jalen Hurts: Williams at QB8, Hurts QB9. It flips if Williams is limited Friday.

Ashton Jeanty: RB13 for me, borderline RB1/RB2, vs BUF. Lean play; it flips if he misses Friday.
#DaBears #FlyEaglesFly #RaiderNation #BillsMafia

Jeremiyah Love: RB18 for me @LAR, an RB2. The lean is play unless he misses Thursday and Friday.

Omarion Hampton vs Woody Marks: Marks. Hampton is RB23 but was third in snaps vs DEN.
#BirdGang #BoltUp #HTownMade

Alvin Kamara vs Kendre Miller: Miller had all 4 red-zone carries in Week 5. Kamara is RB26, a high-end RB3, and the lean is sit unless he is full Friday.

Rashee Rice: WR27 for me, and the lean is sit unless he practices in full by Friday.
#Saints #ChiefsKingdom

Every call with its numbers and what flips it is on the site, and Prep Notes updates the ranks Friday after the final injury report. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/line.html?week=6
